court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Vaibhav S/O Shivaji Wankhede And 5 ... vs State Of Mah. Thr. Pso Mahagaon

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vaibhav s/o Shivaji Wankhede, aged 32 years, Occupation Service, and 4 others
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra through Police Station Officer, Mahagaon, District Yavatmal, and Shital Vaibhav Wankhede, aged about 30 years, occupation Houseold

facts_of_case: Applicants are husband and wife seeking divorce by mutual consent. They have already filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial disputes, irreconcilable differences between the husband and wife are a relevant factor.
legal_principles.held: Considering the fact that this is a matrimonial dispute and the differences between the husband and wife are irreconcilable, it would be better from the view point of the future of

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the fact that a couple has filed a petition for divorce by mutual consent as a relevant factor.
legal_principles.held: Both of them have already filed a petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking divorce by mutual consent.

outcome.final_order: Rule made returnable forthwith. Heard finally by consent of the learned counsel appearing for the parties.
